notes:
- **(Linux) The player controls hide again when you move to another screen.**
  If you slid the mouse off the video onto a second monitor and carried on
  working there, the title bar and the playback controls stayed on screen over
  the film for as long as you kept moving. They now fade away a couple of
  seconds after the pointer leaves the video, the same as they do when it sits
  still.
- **(Linux) The screen no longer blanks in the middle of a film.** On Ubuntu
  and other Linux desktops the screen could dim and lock while a video was
  playing, because the desktop never heard that anything was going on. The
  player now tells it directly, and stops as soon as you pause or leave the
  player, so the screen still sleeps normally the rest of the time.
